name: fh-guard
description: fh-guard — install it and every Bash call your Claude Code agent makes, in any repo, goes through the FH destructive-op gate first. In bypassPermissions and auto mode (no human approves the call) it blocks force pushes, remote branch and tag deletes, git reset --hard and the other local destroyers, and the agent switching the next layer off (--no-verify, core.hooksPath, an override written into the command); the block text tells the agent to ask you, never how to get past. In other modes it warns. 0 skills, 0 agents, no network, writes no files. If the gate cannot start or times out, the Bash call is blocked; if python3 is missing, a one-line notice says the gate is not active. Needs bash and python3 (on Windows, Git for Windows).
